decisions.reason: Correcting the token ID shown in mint-success feedback does not change the USDC approval-to-mint execution requirement.
The source changes success-modal token identification and does not alter the deferred Transak fiat-mint provider, conversion flow, or payment methods.
The success-modal token ID has no effect on mint pricing or revenue allocation.
The source concerns feedback during a USDC attempt and does not change ETH-funded mint execution.
Displaying the current minted token ID does not change automatic fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, holdings, or access paths.
The success-modal token ID does not affect ETH exact-output swapping or excess-refund behavior.
The source does not change currency disclosure, payment-method selection, or card-option availability.
The success-modal token ID is unrelated to the mint-page tipping controls and amounts.
The source specifies runtime success-modal behavior but does not request any FAQ copy change.
Correcting the token ID displayed in a success popup does not change which owned NFTs the dashboard must display or count.
The source does not change referral-commission triggers, recipients, amounts, or payout behavior.
The popup must identify the NFT minted by the current purchase, but the source does not change the separate rule that each NFT's own mint number is its permanent referral code.
